author: Doug Eubanks (fork of Josh.5)
description: Ensure all video streams are encoded with H265/HEVC using the hevc_nvenc encoder. Fork of Josh5/encoder_video_hevc_nvenc that adds `-hwaccel_output_format cuda` when NVDEC HW decoding is enabled, keeping decoded frames in GPU memory for a full NVDEC → NVENC pipeline.
name: Video Encoder H265/HEVC - hevc_nvenc (GPU Pipeline)
